Hi Daniel — thanks again for taking the call today. Wanted to capture the quick recap and proposed next steps while it’s fresh: 

Summary from today
- You’re exploring cost-effective inference for customer-facing agents (main bucket: 10–20 req/s, bursts to 80/s)
- Primary constraints: latency < 150ms p50 for short queries, data residency for EU customers, and predictable monthly spend for forecasting
- Current infra: Kubernetes on AWS (m5/g5), 3rd-party LLMs via marketplace integrations

Proposal / next steps
1) Tech deep-dive (60m) with our runtime engineer to validate latency numbers + KV cache approach — proposed week of Mar 2–6
2) Mutual action plan (MAP): we’ll share an initial cost/latency model + recommended model/quantization profile post-deep-dive
3) Security checklist kickoff (if you want to move to dedicated or private) — optional at this stage

Attachments: Redwood-Discovery-Deck.pdf (brief deck + sample benchmark)

If this sounds right, I can send a few windows for the deep-dive. If timing has changed on your side, let me know and we can adjust.

Thanks,
